slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
A figure has line symmetry if a reflection across some line maps the figure onto itself. That line is a line of symmetry.

A regular n-gon has n lines of symmetry. An isosceles triangle with exactly two equal sides has 1, a rectangle that is not a square has 2, a square has 4 and a circle has infinitely many. A paper snowflake folded into sixths has the 6 lines of a regular hexagon.
